jd:
At Saputo, we bring good to the table by making high-quality products, investing in our people, and supporting communities around the world . As a top 10 global dairy processor, we value contributions that matter and strive to foster an inclusive, growth-driven work environment. Ready to bring your best?

About The Role

The Data Engineer Intern will help build and support scalable analytics solutions on Microsoft Fabric. Working with engineers, analysts and business stakeholders, the intern will help translate requirements into reliable data pipelines and usable datasets, analytics and AI-enabled solutions. The role includes data preparation, modeling, reporting, testing and documentation.

The internship will run from May 10 to August 13, 2027.

What You'll Do



- Build or support ingestion and transformation pipelines using Python, SQL, PySpark, notebooks and Data Factory. 
- Organize, validate and optimize data in Fabric Lakehouse/OneLake; assist with data quality checks and troubleshooting. 
- Create or support Power BI reports, data models and DAX measures; test and document solutions with the team. 


What You'll Bring



- Studies in Computer Science, Software/Computer Engineering, Data Science/Data Engineering, Software Development, AI/Machine Learning or a related field. 
- Foundational Python and SQL; exposure to pipelines, data transformation, databases, APIs or data lakes. 
- Basic Power BI modeling/visualization; analytical, communication, teamwork and learning skills. 
- Microsoft Fabric, Azure or PySpark familiarity is an asset, not a requirement. 


AT SAPUTO, YOU WILL…



- Write the future of the industry: Work with a team seeking better and more efficient ways to meet industry challenges. 
- Have an impact on day one: Contribute through hands-on work and the talents you bring. 
- Grow in your own way: Develop your skills and explore your career path through the internship. 


SALARY RANGE

Starting at $21.90 per hour

Saputo supports employment equity and strives to embed diversity and inclusion in its operations. Candidates from all backgrounds are invited to apply.

In Canada, Saputo is a leading cheese manufacturer and fluid milk and cream processor, with a portfolio of well-loved brands such as Dairyland, Armstrong, Neilson, Alexis de Portneuf, and many more. Whether your expertise lies in manufacturing, operations, supply chain management, sales, quality assurance, or in any other function, your role is integral to our success. You will make contributions that matter, all while working alongside colleagues who genuinely care about your success and who will roll up their sleeves to help.

jd:
Company Information

PACCAR is a global technology leader in the design, manufacture and customer support of high-quality light-, medium- and heavy-duty trucks under the Kenworth, Peterbilt and DAF nameplates. PACCAR also designs and manufactures advanced power trains, provides financial services and information technology, and distributes truck parts related to its principal business.

Peterbilt Motors Company

On highways, construction sites, city streets, logging roads - everywhere our customers earn their living - Peterbilt's red oval is a familiar symbol of performance, reliability and pride. Peterbilt has reigned as America's premium quality truck manufacturer since the company's founding in 1939. Our dedication to deliver products and services focused on improving customers' performance, image, profitability and peace of mind truly makes Peterbilt the Class of the Industry.

Requisition Summary

Peterbilt Motors Company, a PACCAR Company, has an internship for students currently enrolled in college. This opening is for a Data Scientist Intern to add to our Advanced Analytics team in Denton, Texas.

Job Responsibilities

This position will be working on various projects and reports to include but not limited to:



- Write complex SQL queries, including joins, aggregations, common table expressions, and window functions, to prepare and analyze data.
- Develop scalable data science solutions, from exploratory analysis, hypothesis testing, and feature engineering through model development, validation, deployment, and monitoring.
- Apply machine learning, statistical methods, decision models, and Generative AI methodologies to transform data into actionable business insights.
- Collaborate with senior team members to understand business needs, translate those needs into analytical problems, and communicate updates and results clearly.
- Develop Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG) workflows using embeddings, vector databases, and build harness engineered LLM workflows under the guidance of senior team members.
- Build, test, deploy, and monitor AI solutions using cloud platforms and managed services such as AWS Bedrock, Google Cloud Agent Platform (previously Vertex AI), or Azure AI Foundry.
- Use GitHub for version control and team collaboration and apply Markdown-Driven Development (MDD) best practices to agent-assisted solution development.
- Document methodologies, assumptions, designs, test results, and operational procedures while following responsible AI, privacy, security, and model governance standards.

Required Qualifications

The candidate we seek will currently be enrolled in a bachelor’s or master’s degree program in Computer Science, Data Science, Statistics, Business Analytics, Information Systems, or a related quantitative program.

The Candidate Should Also Have



- Strong analytical, problem-solving, organizational, and written and verbal communication skills.
- Python Programming experience and its data science ecosystem (e.g., pandas, scikit-learn, plotly, numpy, scipy), including modular development, object-oriented programming, testing, exception handling, and logging.
- Working knowledge of SQL, including the ability to develop queries using joins, aggregations, and window functions.
- Good Knowledge of Machine Learning, statistical analysis, LLMs and Data Science concepts.
- Experience developing solutions using one or more cloud platforms, such as AWS, Google Cloud Platform, or Microsoft Azure.
- Experience analyzing data, evaluating results, and communicating findings to both technical and non-technical audiences.
- Ability to work collaboratively with team members and stakeholders in a project-based environment.
- Understanding of responsible AI principles, including privacy, security, bias, explainability, and model governance.

Preferred Qualifications

The qualifications that are important to be successful in this position are as follows:



- Experience working with Snowflake and writing SQL for data preparation and analysis.
- Experience using Git-based development workflows, including branching, pull requests, and release management.
- Familiarity with Large Language Models, Decision Models, prompt engineering, embedding, tool-calling workflows, and multi-step agents both using open source (Langgraph) and managed cloud AI services.
- Experience using managed Generative AI services, such as AWS Bedrock, Google Cloud Agent Platform (previously Vertex AI), or Azure AI Foundry.
- Design solution architectures for machine learning, RAG, and agent-based applications, including model selection, retrieval strategy, orchestration, evaluation, observability, version control, testing, and production monitoring.
- Experience developing Retrieval-Augmented Generation solutions using a vector database, such as pgvector, Pinecone, or an equivalent platform.
- Familiarity with MLOps practices, including version control (Git), and experiment tracking (MLflow, OpenTelemetry, Arize Phoenix, or similar).
- Design and execute experiments, including A/B tests and hypothesis tests, and translate findings into clear business recommendations.

General Description Of Internship Benefits

As a U.S. PACCAR intern, you have a full range of benefit options including:



- Competitive salary and 401k with up to a 5% company match
- Medical, dental, and vision plans for you and your family
- Paid holidays
- Flexible spending accounts (FSA) and health savings account (HSA)
- Life and accidental death and dismemberment insurance
- EAP services including wellness plans, estate planning, financial counseling and more
- Global Fortune 500 company with a wide array of growth, training, and development opportunities
- Work alongside experienced goal-oriented colleagues recognized as experts in their field
- This position may offer stipend assistance benefits

Additional Job Board Information

PACCAR is an E-Verify & Equal Opportunity Employer/Protected Veteran/Disability corporation. Peterbilt promotes Diversity and Inclusion through mentorship, events, and affinity support groups – The Diversity Council, Peterbilt Women’s Initiative (PBWIN), Veterans Group, Peterbilt Black Organization for Leadership and Development (B.O.L.D) and Peterbilt+ (An LGBTQ support group).
fit_why: Strong AI/LLM, SQL, Python overlap; data science/ML-heavy, lighter on modelling

role: DoD SkillBridge Internship - Cybersecurity Software and Systems Engineer
jd:
We have an exciting opportunity for a DOD Skillbridge Fellowship - Cybersecurity Software and Systems Engineer to join our team.

At our company, we help transitioning service members, from all branches of the U.S. Military, prepare for new opportunities and connections in their careers. Do you want to work onsite at NASA in Houston with a dynamic team to create the cybersecurity software and systems engineering backbone? If so, this opportunity may be for you.

Our company has teamed up with the Department of Defense (DoD) SkillBridge Program to provide career opportunities in:



-  This is a temporary role not to exceed 6 months. **

DOD SkillBridge Fellowship - Cybersecurity Software and Systems Engineer: Collaborate with the NASA/JETS Cybersecurity Engineering team and develop an intimate knowledge of Cybersecurity Software and Systems Engineering. Learn and perform the following tasks:



- Spacecraft Cybersecurity Engineering- Develop cybersecurity requirements for spacecraft systems
- Learn to perform cybersecurity oversight and impact assessments
- Perform assessment for completeness of design and implementation throughout the full software and hardware development lifecycle
- Help define NASA's integrated cybersecurity effort
- Help collect and organize the cybersecurity architecture elements such as Needs, Goals, Objectives, Capabilities, Processes, and Use Cases
- Work with a variety of NASA leadership teams including JSC engineering to develop the needs of NASA cybersecurity
- Learn the team/project goals, track progress, and provide weekly status reporting
- Other duties as assigned

NOTE: SkillBridge Fellowship will not be eligible for any compensation during their internship, as they will continue to receive all military pay and benefits. Upon successful completion of this internship, you will be well prepared and encouraged to apply for open positions listed on our careers page.

Here's What You'll Need:



- To have served at least 180 days in any of the U.S. Armed Forces
- To be within 180 days of separation or retirement from any of the U.S. Armed Forces (you may start your application prior to the 180 days)
- Must be on track to receive an Honorable Discharge
- Must have taken any service TAPS/TGPS
- Must have attended or participated in an ethics brief within the last 12 months
- Must have command approval to participate in the DoD SkillBridge program
- Must be able and willing to work onsite at JSC in Houston 5 days per week. 
- Must be a self-starter able to perform other duties as required or assigned

Ideally, you'll have:



- Computer Science or Engineering degree or equivalent work experience
- Experience/exposure with cybersecurity software and systems engineering
- Excellent communication, negotiation and coordination skills
- Ability to collaborate/coordinate across diverse groups
- Excellent organizational skills
- Self-starter who can understand and absorb new concepts quickly
- Proficiency with Microsoft Office skills (Outlook, Word, Excel, Teams)
- Keen interest in working for NASA and advancing NASA's mission

Why Join Our Team?

In addition to exciting career opportunities, we also ave:



- Excellent personal and professional career growth
- 9/80 work schedule (every other Friday off), when applicable
- Onsite cafeteria (breakfast & lunch)
- Much, much more!

For more information on our partnership with NASA at Johnson Space Center (JSC), please visit www.wehavespaceforyou.com



- Proof of U.S. Citizenship or US Permanent Residency may be a requirement for this position. 
- Must be able to complete a U.S. government background investigation. 
- Management has the prerogative to select at any level for which the position is advertised. 

Essential Functions

Work Environment

Generally, an office environment, but can involve inside or outside work depending on task.

Physical Requirements

Work may involve sitting or standing for extended periods (90% of time). May require lifting and carrying up to 25 lbs. (5% of time).

Equipment and Machines

Standard office equipment (PC, telephone, printer, etc.).

Attendance

Regular attendance in accordance with established work schedule is critical. Ability to work outside normal schedule and adjust schedule to meet peak periods and surge requirements.

Other Essential Functions

Professional behavior that enhances productivity and promotes teamwork and cooperation. Grooming and dress must be appropriate for the position and must not impose a safety risk/hazard to the employee or others.
